item.title: The 'Speed Watches' Reaction Image Has Been Growing On TikTok Over The Past Few Months
item.description: Speed Watches or IShowSpeed Watches is an exploitable reaction meme based on a clip from IShowSpeed's 'EARLY STREAM' where IShowSpeed nods and smiles while holding his chin. The meme was popularized on sites like TikTok and Reels through December 2025 and January 2026, mostly as a reaction image in comment sections. It also inspired edits, including an edit where Speed has been given large eyes and drool pours from his mouth.

item.title: 'Key And Peele' Sketch Inspires Memes About Telling Your Mom To Shut Up
item.description: Keith She Sounds Wonderful or Shut Up, Mom refers to a scene from the Key and Peele sketch "Sibling Rivalry" where Jordan Peele, playing Clive, yells, "Shut up, mom! Silence from you," after his mother compliments his brother Keith's fiancée, saying, "Keith she sounds wonderful." The episode aired in December 2014. item.title: 'Fallout' Star 'Ella Purnell' Stuns And Baffles With Her Big Eyes, Inspiring A Whole Lot Of Memes
item.description: Ella Purnell's Eyes refers to memes about the size of actress Ella Purnell's eyes, which appear larger than average. Memes about Purnell's eyes started going viral online as early as April 2024, with some of the earliest and most common memes comparing Purnell's eyes to those of the Woody Woodpecker character Splinter. Memes about her eyes continued to grow in popularity through 2025. Purnell is best known for her acting roles in Fallout and Yellowjackets.

item.title: Lucy Calling The NCR 'Vaguely Problematic' In New 'Fallout' Episode Sparks Debates In The Fandom
